rules.rule: Audit reports only; edits nothing until approved, nothing applied on silence
must: Report only\.
nothing is applied on silence
audit \(default\): report findings by severity, edit nothing until approved

rules.rule: When the request does not settle the mode, default to audit because it edits nothing
must: default to\s+audit \(it edits nothing\)

rules.rule: Real-world technical claims are flagged as questions, never silently rewritten
must: Internal consistency you resolve; real-world technical accuracy you flag
never silently\s+rewritten or "corrected" with a fact you cannot ground

rules.rule: Create: an unsettled fact stays out of the text and goes on the reply's open list, never a TODO in the file
must: goes on the reply's open list, never a `TODO` in the file

rules.rule: State path and what changed; never paste the document back into chat
must: never paste the document back into chat

rules.rule: After any edit, re-check against the ledger for contradiction, drift, orphan, duplicate
must: Coherence check — after any edit, re-check it against the ledger
contradict a distant claim, drift the terminology, orphan a\s+reference, or duplicate a point

rules.rule: Proof fixes only what has one right answer; ambiguous contradictions are flagged as questions
must: Reserve edits for what has one right answer; flag the rest
Fix a contradiction only when the intended meaning is\s+unambiguous

rules.rule: Create is not reported finished until the whole-document pass on the written file has run and fixes are in
must: Nothing is reported as finished until\s+the pass has run and its fixes are in

rules.rule: Audit findings grouped by severity, numbered 1..n across groups, with both locations for contradictions, verdict and counts
must: numbered in\s+one run across the groups — 1\.\.n, not restarting at each heading
a contradiction cites both locations
End with a verdict

rules.rule: Scope is the named files; an out-of-scope contradiction is flagged, not dropped or edited
must: Flag a\s+contradiction the pass surfaces in a file outside that scope rather than drop\s+it

rules.rule: Proof reports a flat list of edit classes with counts plus open questions, not severity groups
must: Proof reports as a flat list, not audit's numbered severity groups

rules.rule: An audit opens with a scope line naming the files read; it is not preamble
must: The scope line an audit opens with is exempt
it is the first fact, not\s+preamble
